business_summary: Musashi Co., Ltd. provides information/industrial, printing, cash handling, and election systems equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers media conversion services to digitalize documents and microfilms; data entry services; and information processing services, including production of microfilm images. It also engages in the consultation and sale of scanners, electronic archive systems, and other products, as well as manufacture and sale of thermal enlarger printers and thermal papers; industrial non-destructive inspection systems for buildings and manufactured products; and development and sale of image processing software. In addition, the company consults and sells printing equipment, materials, and software for digital pre-press systems and print-on-demand systems, and laser systems; and develops and sells a compact print-on-demand system for business cards and cards, as well as provides maintenance services for equipment. Further, it offers cash handling machines for various industries, such as finance, retail, courier, transport, and entertainment under the tellac name; security products comprising administrative products for keys; and exports cash handling machines consisting of bill counters and bill binding machines to international markets. Additionally, the company provides election systems equipment, such as ballot paper dispensers, counters, reader sorters, issuers, self-opening ballot papers, administrative software, promotional items, and other tools; and various types of paper and paperboards for printing, publishing, information, administration, and other special applications, as well as processed paper products. It also engages in real estate and auto leasing, as well as insurance brokerage activities. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
